visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with messy black hair wearing a black zip-up hoodie sits at a wooden table in front of a white paneled wall. His facial expression is somber and exhausted. A hand enters from the left and places a white plate holding a single, paper-thin, nearly transparent slice of white bread in front of him. He stares at the bread with a hollow gaze before slowly using his fingers to lift the fragile slice. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor balcony overlooking a hazy, gray city skyline. It is raining heavily. The man, now dressed in a purple sleeveless tank top, holds a large white plastic washbasin to catch rainwater dripping from the roof. He uses a small green plastic scoop to direct the flow. The lighting is dim and natural, emphasizing the gloomy and damp atmosphere of the rainy day. (3) In a brightly lit indoor kitchen, the man carefully pours the collected rainwater from the large white basin into a white ceramic mug featuring a pink cartoon character. He holds the mug with both hands and takes a slow, deliberate sip of the water, maintaining a resigned and miserable facial expression. The background shows a clean kitchen counter, a gas stove, and white cabinetry. (4) The man is back in his black zip-up hoodie, squatting on a light-colored tiled floor next to a white French Bulldog. A light blue plastic dog bowl sits on the floor between them. The man rests his chin on his hand, looking weary and defeated, while the dog sits patiently and looks up at him. The setting is a simple, modern interior living space with minimalist decor. (5) In a brightly lit building hallway with shiny, reflective floors, the man squats near a wall outlet to charge his smartphone using a white cable. He looks around cautiously. Suddenly, he appears startled by something off-screen. He quickly unplugs the charging cable, grabs his phone, and sprints down the hallway away from the camera, his body in a full running motion as he disappears through a doorway.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A slow, melancholy piano BGM begins, setting a sad and dramatic tone. The music is sparse with gentle resonances. There is a faint sound of a plate being placed on a wooden surface, followed by the subtle rustle of dry fingers picking up a light object. (2) The acoustic texture changes as the sound of continuous falling rain becomes audible, creating a wet nature ambient floor. The piano melody persists underneath the rain sounds. A hollow plastic splashing sound occurs twice as water is scooped and collected. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound follows, indicating water being transferred into a mug. This is followed by a clear swallowing sound. The piano BGM continues with a consistent, slow tempo, providing a somber emotional backdrop to the mundane domestic sounds. (4) The audio returns to a quiet indoor room tone with very low-level background hum. The piano music remains steady. A very faint percussive clicking sound, similar to a dog's claws on a hard floor, is briefly audible beneath the melodic piano notes. (5) A sudden, high-intensity male voice shouts aggressively: '你這王八!' (Nǐ zhè wángbā!). The shout is loud and sharp. Immediately following this, there is a mechanical clicking sound of a plug being pulled, followed by the rapid, thumping sound of running footsteps and clothing rustle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the extreme financial hardship someone might face after buying a house once the interest-only grace period ends, leading to absurd levels of frugality like eating paper-thin bread and stealing electricity.
